name: Hertzian nonlinear contact theory
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 以非线性弹性压缩关系表达轮轨法向接触的理论。
usage_note: 该段采用二维简化模型并以计算效率及已有验证为依据。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道耦合动力模型中的轮轨法向接触计算，根据接触变形求取非线性轮轨力，将车辆与钢轨的动力响应联系起来。

complete_examples.text: The wheel–rail force can be calculated using the Hertzian nonlinear contact theory.
The wheel-rail interaction submodel based on Hertzian nonlinear contact theory is the same as those in Refs.39–41.
